"""Keep the settings inventory complete as environment-backed keys change."""

import ast
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SETTINGS_DIR = ROOT / "noah" / "settings"
INVENTORY = ROOT / "docs" / "feature-flags.md"


def _environment_keys() -> set[str]:
    keys = set()
    for settings_file in SETTINGS_DIR.glob("*.py"):
        for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(settings_file.read_text())):
            if not isinstance(node, ast.Call) or not node.args:
                continue
            func = node.func
            is_env = isinstance(func, ast.Name) and func.id == "env"
            is_env_method = (
                isinstance(func, ast.Attribute)
                and isinstance(func.value, ast.Name)
                and func.value.id == "env"
            )
            key = node.args[0]
            if (is_env or is_env_method) and isinstance(key, ast.Constant):
                if isinstance(key.value, str):
                    keys.add(key.value)
    return keys


def test_every_settings_environment_key_is_in_the_inventory():
    docs = INVENTORY.read_text()
    inventory = docs.split("## Environment-backed settings inventory", 1)[1].split(
        "## Harness run config", 1
    )[0]
    missing = sorted(key for key in _environment_keys() if f"`{key}`" not in inventory)
    assert not missing, "Add these settings to docs/feature-flags.md: " + ", ".join(
        missing
    )
